description_en: Deletes an encrypted parameter. Ensure that you have the permission to call the KMS DeleteSecret API operation before calling this operation
description_zh: 删除一个加密参数。请确保在使用该接口前有操作kms DeleteSecret API的权限
kebab_example: aliyun oos delete-secret-parameter --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MySecretParameter --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteSecretParameter

parameters.help_en: The name of the encrypted parameter. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The name can be up to 180 characters in length and cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, ALICLOUD, or OOS
parameters.help_zh: 加密参数名称。取值范围：内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度不能超过180字符，且不能以ALIYUN、ACS、ALIBABA、ALICLOUD、OOS开头
parameters.name: name
